They are made from the platform's own help guides and are brought up to date with every release, so new features appear in them by themselves. They are kept by the platform and cannot be edited or deleted; your own articles are untouched. Agents find them in the desk's Knowledge panel; the Knowledge page shows when each was last updated.

Search: find any screen from the Search button in the top bar, or Ctrl K (⌘ K on a Mac), by its name or what you want to do. It offers only the screens your role may open.

Conferences: an agent who leaves a conference, or drops out of it, can rejoin while the customer and the others are still talking. The desk shows who is still on the call and a Rejoin conference button; the agent's phone rings and joins the same conference.

Templates for three more industries, across assist playbooks, quality forms, outcomes, scripts with wrap-up forms, quick replies, knowledge articles, surveys, wallboards, alert rules and service-level policies:

- Betting and gaming: verification and FICA, deposits and withdrawals, bet settlement and disputes, bonuses without pressure, and responsible gambling throughout (limits, cooling-off, self-exclusion, the NRGP helpline 0800 006 008).
- Short-term insurance: FAIS disclosures, first notice of loss to write-offs, theft and hijacking, geysers and storms, travel and cell phone claims, renewals with reasons, cancellations, and complaints to the National Financial Ombud.
- Life insurance: needs analysis and advice records, underwriting and medicals, waiting periods and exclusions, beneficiaries, lapses and reinstatement, disability and dread disease claims, and gentle death-claim handling.
  Details a compliance officer must confirm for your business are left in [square brackets]."}
